comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
In other servers, this edition of the Sea Dragon's Robe is dropped from the Sea Monster Treasure Chest item (which is itself can potentially obtained from Ultramarine/Azure Cetus upon his defeat). Stats:

Durability 100
Disguise 30
Defense 60

Reloading +2
Penetration +2
Gunnery +2
EX Effect: Focus (Fire & Flood) R1

As you can see, the stats are identical to the craftable Sea Monster's Robe outfit but for the EX Effect.

Source: tyojyuhei.web.fc2.com/dol_body.html

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Okay, fine. They call these things Sea Monster's Robe now. Got it. Never did understand why it was called Sea Dragon's Robe in the first place...
